title: Google AI gets cagey when asked who won the 2020 elections
gist: Google's AI Mode in Search gave evasive, link-only answers when asked who won the 2020 (and sometimes 2024) US presidential election, while Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude and AI Mode accessed from abroad answered directly. Google said a 'technical gap' in its election verification for 2020 and 2022 Senate races caused it and is being fixed.

insights.claim: Asked 'Who won the 2020 presidential election?', Google's AI Mode told the reporter to consult the FEC rather than naming Joe Biden, while answering correctly for every other election back to 2000 except 2012 and 2024.
insights.speaker: Kyle Orland
insights.so_what: AI search answer behavior on politically sensitive facts is unpredictable.

insights.so_what: Nondeterministic guardrails undermine trust in AI search as an authoritative source.
